title: Freight Inquiry & Logistics Support | Vidhi Transport
description: Send Vidhi Transport a freight inquiry for PTL, FTL, project cargo, containers, warehousing, routes, pickup planning or general service support.

hero.title: Give us the details behind the movement.
hero.subtitle: Three details make the first reply more useful.
intro: Send a route-specific freight inquiry for PTL, FTL, chemical and industrial freight, project cargo, containers, warehousing or general support.
A short but precise shipment brief helps the team route your inquiry correctly.
list: Exact pickup and delivery locations with PIN codes
Material, packaging, package count, dimensions and weight
Ready date, urgency and loading or unloading needs

sections.title: A complete enquiry moves faster.
intro: Do not rely only on a city pair or approximate weight. Industrial freight decisions depend on the actual goods, packaging, handling conditions and receiving arrangement.

cards.title: Route
body: Share the exact pickup and delivery industrial areas, PIN codes, gate conditions and receiving hours.

cards.title: Cargo
body: Name the material and provide classification, packaging, package count, dimensions, gross weight and stackability.

cards.title: Timing
body: Provide the ready date, delivery requirement, urgency and whether forklift, crane, dock or labour is available.

sections.title: Send an inquiry
intro: Complete the form below and review your information before sending. Please do not enter passwords, banking credentials or unrelated confidential documents.
If the embedded form is blocked by the browser, open the same form in a separate tab.

sections.title: Prefer WhatsApp or email?
sections.subtitle: Need a person?
intro: The detailed contact page prepares a structured business message containing the route, cargo, packaging, weight, service, billing and delivery choices. You remain in control of the message and review it before sending through your chosen application.
For an existing consignment, include the LR number. For new freight, keep the route and cargo profile ready.

faqs.q: Which details help Vidhi Transport answer a freight inquiry?
faqs.a: Provide exact origin and destination, cargo description, packaging, package count, dimensions, total weight, ready date, loading and unloading needs, and the required delivery arrangement.

faqs.q: Can I use the inquiry form for both PTL and FTL?
faqs.a: Yes. If you are unsure which service fits, describe the shipment accurately and ask the operations team to recommend the practical movement option.

faqs.q: Does submitting the inquiry confirm a booking?
faqs.a: No. Submission begins a review. Freight rate, service acceptance, vehicle placement, pickup date, transit expectation and delivery arrangement require separate confirmation.

faqs.q: What should I do if the embedded form does not load?
faqs.a: Use the button below the form to open it directly, or use the main contact and quotation page to prepare a WhatsApp or email enquiry.
